basic_info.description: Welcome to 170 King Street, where luxury meets the perfect location! Step into this chic 1 bed, 1 bath condo, dappled in natural light, with tall ceilings, and an open floor plan great for entertaining! The bedroom looks out onto the pool/hot tub area. A spacious walk-in closet leads to the bathroom with dual sinks and a tub with shower. The kitchen contains a welcoming bar next to the breakfast nook. In-unit washer and dryer and office nook make for a turn-key experience. Secure 1-car garage parking and storage. Amenities include a club lounge, pool, hot tub, BBQ, gym, movie theater, and a roof terrace with stunning San Francisco Skyline views. Newly painted interior throughout.   Located in the vibrant South Beach neighborhood across the street from Oracle Park, close to restaurants, cafés, and the freeway. A baseball lover’s dream location.
